description: Search FDA/CMS healthcare sources. openfda_drug_recalls (default): FDA drug enforcement/recall reports — keyword matches product description or recalling firm. openfda_device_510k: FDA 510(k) clearances — keyword matches device name or applicant. npi_registry: NPPES NPI registry — keyword is an organization-name prefix (city/state refine; an exact NPI goes in the apn field); phone numbers and authorized-official contacts are never returned. FDA warning letters have no openFDA endpoint (separate planned entry); CMS Open Payments is archived 2015–2022 and blocked as a live source — see fedwatch_sources.

keyword.description: Keyword: product/firm (recalls), device/applicant (510k), organization name prefix (NPI)

source_id.description: Source id: openfda_drug_recalls (default), openfda_device_510k, or npi_registry

status.description: Recalls only: exact FDA status, e.g. 'Ongoing'

name: healthcare_search
